records.definition_zh: 嘔吐是指胃內容物經口（有時兼經鼻）強力排出體外的病證，俗稱「吐」。
records.definition_en: Vomiting (known informally as throwing up) is the forceful expulsion of the contents of the stomach through the mouth and sometimes the nose.
records.etiology_zh: 一為外邪侵襲（外感）；二為飲食不節，損傷脾胃（急性者食滯內停，慢性者如食物過敏、痰飲內生）；三為情志所傷，肝氣犯胃；四為脾胃虛弱（脾陽虛、胃陰虛）。
records.etiology_en: Per the handout's TCM section: (1) invasion of external pathogens; (2) improper diet injuring the spleen and stomach (acute food retention; chronic conditions such as food allergies with phlegm-fluid); (3) emotional injury with liver qi attacking the stomach; (4) deficiency of the spleen and stomach (spleen yang deficiency, stomach yin deficiency).
records.pathomechanism_zh: 諸因均致胃失和降、胃氣上逆而發為嘔吐：外邪犯胃、食滯中脘、痰飲內停、肝氣犯胃者屬實；脾陽虛衰、胃陰不足、胃失濡養溫煦者屬虛。（講義未設病機專節，此據各證治則「和胃降逆」歸納。）
records.pathomechanism_en: In all cases the stomach loses its harmonious downward movement and stomach qi rebels upward, producing vomiting: invasion of external pathogens, food retention, phlegm-fluid accumulation, and liver qi attacking the stomach constitute the excess side, while spleen yang deficiency and stomach yin deficiency constitute the deficiency side. (The handout has no dedicated pathomechanism section; this is summarized from its treatment principles of regulating the stomach and descending stomach qi.)
key_manifestations_zh: 胃內容物經口強力吐出
噁心
汗出
面色蒼白
心動過速
key_manifestations_en: Forceful expulsion of stomach contents through the mouth
Nausea
Sweating
Pale face
Tachycardia

records.definition_zh: 吞酸指胃中酸水上泛、逆流入食道之病證。本講義以西醫胃食道逆流病（GERD）立論：因下食道括約肌（LES）功能不全，胃酸持續逆流入食道，刺激損傷黏膜，臨床以胃灼熱與泛酸為主症，為最常見之食道疾病。
records.definition_en: Tun suan (acid regurgitation) denotes sour gastric fluid surging upward into the esophagus. The handout presents it as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD): a chronic condition in which gastric acid flows back into the esophagus due to lower esophageal sphincter (LES) incompetence, irritating and damaging the mucosa; heartburn and regurgitation are the cardinal symptoms, and it is the most common esophageal disease.
records.etiology_zh: 講義所列危險因子：肥胖（腹內壓增高）、食道裂孔疝（胃酸更易逆流）、懷孕（激素與機械性壓迫）、抽菸與飲酒（鬆弛下食道括約肌）、嗜食辛辣油膩（誘發逆流）。中醫方面，講義指出肝胃不和型之逆流多由情志緊張（壓力）誘發。
records.etiology_en: Risk factors listed in the handout: obesity (raised intra-abdominal pressure), hiatal hernia (allows acid to reflux more easily), pregnancy (hormonal and mechanical pressure), smoking and alcohol (both relax the LES), and spicy or fatty food (triggers reflux). On the TCM side, the handout notes that reflux of the Liver-invading-Stomach type is triggered by emotional stress.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 下食道括約肌鬆弛，胃酸逆流入食道，致黏膜刺激與糜爛；久病可發展為Barrett食道（腸化生），進而增加腺癌風險。中醫整合部分分三型：肝胃不和、胃熱上逆、脾胃虛寒，皆以酸水上逆為共同病機表現。
records.pathomechanism_en: LES incompetence permits acid reflux into the esophagus, causing mucosal irritation and erosion; if chronic, Barrett esophagus (intestinal metaplasia) may develop, raising the risk of adenocarcinoma. The TCM integration section differentiates three types — Liver invading Stomach, Stomach heat rebelling upward, and Spleen-Stomach deficiency cold — all sharing upward counterflow of acid as the common mechanism.
key_manifestations_zh: 胃灼熱，餐後、平臥、彎腰時加重
泛酸／胃酸逆流，口中有酸苦味
吞嚥困難（警訊症狀，須排除食道狹窄或惡性病變）
胸痛（須先排除心源性病因）
慢性咳嗽、聲音沙啞（食道外／非典型表現）
key_manifestations_en: Heartburn, worse after meals, when lying flat, or bending over
Regurgitation of gastric acid with a sour or bitter taste in the mouth
Dysphagia (alarm symptom; rule out stricture or malignancy)
Chest pain (cardiac cause must be ruled out first)
Chronic cough and hoarseness (extra-esophageal / atypical presentation)

records.definition_zh: 呃逆係指膈肌不自主收縮,呃聲頻頻,一分鐘內可反覆多次發作,不能自制的病證。
records.definition_en: Hiccup refers to an involuntary contraction of the diaphragm that may repeat several times per minute.
records.etiology_zh: 西醫病因:進食過速,碳酸飲料與酒,某些藥物。中醫病因分虛實:實者為胃中寒冷、胃火上逆、氣鬱痰阻(每因情志緊張、焦慮而誘發);虛者為胃陽不足、胃陰虧虛。
records.etiology_en: Western causes given in the handout: rapid eating; carbonated beverages and alcohol; certain drugs. In Chinese medicine the causes divide into excess conditions — stomach cold, stomach fire, and qi-phlegm stagnation (induced by stress or anxiety) — and deficiency conditions — stomach yang deficiency and stomach yin deficiency.
key_manifestations_zh: 呃聲頻作,不能自制,一分鐘內可反覆多次
胃寒者呃聲深長有力,胃脘冷痛;胃火者呃聲洪亮清晰有力,口舌生瘡
氣鬱痰阻者呃逆連連不止,兼嘔吐,遇情志緊張焦慮而發
胃陽虛者呃聲低弱沉緩,肢冷倦怠,納差;胃陰虛者呃聲短促急速,口乾唇燥而渴
key_manifestations_en: Repeated involuntary hiccups that may recur several times per minute
In stomach cold the sound is deep, long and forceful with cramping stomach pain; in stomach fire it is loud, clear and forceful with mouth ulcers
In qi-phlegm stagnation the hiccups are continuous with vomiting, induced by stress or anxiety
In stomach yang deficiency the sound is weak, deep and low-toned with cold limbs, fatigue and poor appetite; in stomach yin deficiency it is short and quick with thirst and dry mouth, tongue and lips

records.definition_zh: 泄瀉係指排便次數增多,每日三次或以上,糞質稀溏或呈水樣的病證;其病與脾、肝、腎三臟關係最為密切。
records.definition_en: Diarrhea refers to the condition of having three or more loose or liquid bowel movements per day; the zangfu chiefly involved are the spleen, liver, and kidney.
records.etiology_zh: 感受外邪(風、暑、濕、寒、熱);飲食所傷(暴飲暴食);情志失調(郁怒致肝氣鬱結,橫逆乘脾);脾胃虛弱;腎陽虧虛。
records.etiology_en: Affection by external pathogens (wind, summerheat, damp, cold, and heat); dietary injury (overeating); emotional disturbance (anger leading to liver qi stagnation overacting on the spleen); spleen and stomach weakness; kidney yang deficiency.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 外邪侵襲(寒濕、濕熱)或飲食積滯,損傷脾胃,運化失司,發為急性泄瀉,多屬實證;病久不癒,則見肝氣橫逆乘脾、脾胃虛弱不能運化水穀、或腎陽虧虛不能溫煦,轉為慢性泄瀉,多屬虛證;腎陽虛者每於黎明之前腸鳴腹痛而瀉,瀉後始安。病位雖在腸,而關鍵繫於脾,並涉及肝腎。
records.pathomechanism_en: Invasion by external pathogens (cold-damp, damp-heat) or food stagnation injures the spleen and stomach, whose transportation and transformation fail, producing acute diarrhea, mostly of excess type. When prolonged, liver qi overacting on the spleen, spleen-stomach weakness unable to transform food, or kidney yang deficiency failing to warm gives rise to chronic diarrhea, mostly of deficient type; in kidney yang deficiency the diarrhea occurs before dawn, preceded by borborygmus and abdominal pain and eased after the bowel movement. The disease is located in the intestines, with the spleen as the pivot, and also involves the liver and kidney.
key_manifestations_zh: 排便次數明顯增多,每日三次或以上
糞質稀溏,色黃,氣味酸臭,或夾黏液及未消化食物
腹痛
腸鳴
肛門墜重、灼熱
key_manifestations_en: Markedly increased bowel movement frequency, three or more times per day
Loose stool, yellow in color, with a sour odor, mucus, or undigested food
Abdominal pain
Borborygmus
Heavy sensation and burning of the anus

records.definition_zh: 便秘係指排便困難、便後有排便不盡感,且排便次數減少(一般每週三次或以下)的病證。
records.definition_en: Constipation refers to a condition of difficulty during defecation, a sensation of incomplete bowel evacuation, and infrequent bowel movements, typically three times or fewer per week.
records.etiology_zh: 講義所列病因:飲食失宜(膳食纖維與水分攝取不足,嗜食辛辣、乾燥、高蛋白、高脂之品)、藥物所傷、焦慮等情志因素、戒菸、腹部手術、肛門括約肌損傷、腫瘤梗阻、乳糖不耐等。中醫辨其虛實:實者為腸胃積熱與氣機鬱滯;虛者為血虛、陰虛、氣虛、陽虛。
records.etiology_en: Causes listed in the handout: dietary factors (insufficient fiber and water intake; spicy-pungent, dry, high-protein and high-fat foods), medications, anxiety and other psychological factors, smoking cessation, abdominal surgery, damage to the anal sphincter, tumor obstruction, and lactose intolerance. In TCM it is differentiated into excess conditions (gastrointestinal heat and qi stagnation) and deficient conditions (blood deficiency, yin deficiency, qi deficiency, yang deficiency).
records.pathomechanism_zh: 其病機不外排便受阻與腸道傳導遲緩兩端。實者腸胃積熱,津液受灼,或氣機鬱滯,腑氣不通,故大便乾結、排出困難,情志波動則加重;虛者血虛陰虛,腸道失於濡潤,大便乾燥難下,或氣虛陽虛,大腸傳送無力、蠕動遲緩,雖糞便蓄積而便意不生,或雖有便意而努掙難出,便後短氣汗出、疲乏,甚者須賴瀉藥方得一行。
records.pathomechanism_en: The mechanisms fall into two categories: obstructed defecation and hypomotility. In excess patterns, gastrointestinal heat scorches the fluids, or stagnant qi blocks the bowel qi, so the stool is dry and difficult to pass, worsening with emotional fluctuation. In deficiency patterns, blood or yin deficiency deprives the intestines of moistening so the dry stool is hard to pass, or qi and yang deficiency leaves the large intestine without propulsive force and peristalsis slows — the urge to defecate may be absent even when feces have accumulated, or defecation remains difficult and is followed by shortness of breath, sweating and fatigue, in severe cases relying on purgatives.
key_manifestations_zh: 大便乾結,排便困難
排便次數減少,每週三次或以下
便後有排便不盡感
腹部脹滿
或需藉手法或瀉藥始能排便
key_manifestations_en: Dry, hard stool with difficulty in defecation
Infrequent bowel movements, three times or fewer per week
Sensation of incomplete bowel evacuation
Abdominal distension
May require manual maneuvers or purgatives to facilitate defecation

records.definition_zh: 脅痛係指以一側或兩側脅肋部疼痛為主要表現的病證;其病與肝膽、脾胃、腎相關。
records.definition_en: Hypochondriac pain refers to a disorder characterized by pain over the unilateral or bilateral sides of the hypochondriac region; the zangfu involved are the liver and gallbladder, spleen and stomach, and kidney.
records.etiology_zh: 總由外邪侵襲、飲食所傷、七情內傷所致。實證:肝氣鬱結;瘀血停著(氣血運行不暢);肝膽濕熱(痰濕外侵、飲食過度)。虛證:肝陰不足;飲停脅下;少陽經受病(邪鬱少陽)。
records.etiology_en: Caused overall by affection by exterior pathogens, dietary injury, and the seven emotional factors. Excess conditions: liver qi stagnation; blood stasis (failure of the free flow of qi and blood); damp-heat in the liver and gallbladder (phlegm-damp invasion, overeating). Deficiency conditions: liver yin deficiency; fluid retention in the hypochondrium; Shaoyang meridian disease (stagnation of pathogens).
records.pathomechanism_zh: 實者氣滯、血瘀、濕熱壅阻,肝膽氣血失於流暢,不通則痛,故起病急、病程短、痛處拒按,見於體實之人;虛者肝陰虧虛,脈絡失養,不榮則痛,故起病緩、病程長、痛處喜按,見於體弱之人。本病常虛實並見,日久每轉為陰虛與氣滯並存。
records.pathomechanism_en: In excess, qi stagnation, blood stasis, or damp-heat obstruction blocks the free flow of qi and blood in the liver and gallbladder — where there is blockage there is pain — hence rapid onset, short duration, refusal of pressure, and a strong constitution. In deficiency, liver yin insufficiency leaves the vessels unnourished — where there is malnourishment there is pain — hence slow onset, long duration, preference for pressure, and a weak constitution. Hypochondriac pain often presents with both excess and deficiency, and over time evolves into coexisting yin deficiency and qi stagnation.
key_manifestations_zh: 一側或兩側脅肋部疼痛,呈脹痛、刺痛、隱痛、灼痛或絞痛
疼痛可放射至肩背
疼痛每因情志波動而增減
口苦
目視昏花
key_manifestations_en: Pain in the unilateral or bilateral hypochondriac regions — distending, stabbing, dull, burning, or colicky in character
Pain may radiate to the shoulder and back
Pain relieved or exacerbated by emotional fluctuations
Bitter taste in the mouth
Blurred vision

records.definition_zh: 痔瘡係指直腸下端或肛門部靜脈瘀血擴張所形成之柔軟腫塊，以肛門腫痛、瘙癢、便血為主要表現的病證。生於齒線以上、肛內直腸下端者為內痔；生於齒線以下、肛門口者為外痔，可脫出肛外。其病與肝膽、脾胃、腎、肺諸臟腑相關。
records.definition_en: Hemorrhoids are painful, swollen veins in the lower portion of the rectum or anus, presenting mainly with anal pain, itching, and bleeding. Internal hemorrhoids occur just inside the anus above the pectinate line; external hemorrhoids occur at the anal opening below the pectinate line and may hang outside the anus. The zangfu involved are the Liver and Gallbladder, Spleen and Stomach, Kidney, and Lung.
records.etiology_zh: 情志失調、精神緊張；飲食不節；久坐久立；長期便祕或泄瀉。
records.etiology_en: Mental stress; improper diet; prolonged sitting or standing; chronic constipation or diarrhea.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 講義未設專門病機論述，據其證型分類可知：濕熱下注大腸，或風邪襲擾腸絡而動血，或血行瘀滯結聚肛門，或脾虛中氣下陷、升舉無力而痔核脫出，均可發為本病。
records.pathomechanism_en: The handout has no dedicated pathomechanism discussion; from its pattern classification, the disease arises when damp-heat pours into the intestines, or intestinal wind disturbs the collaterals and stirs the blood, or blood stagnates and binds at the anus, or spleen deficiency with sinking qi fails to lift, causing prolapse of the hemorrhoids.
key_manifestations_zh: 肛門瘙癢
肛門痠痛或疼痛
便時見鮮紅血，附於糞便、手紙或滴入便池
排便時疼痛
肛門旁一個或多個質硬觸痛之腫塊
key_manifestations_en: Anal itching
Anal ache or pain
Bright red blood on toilet tissue, stool, or in the toilet bowl
Pain during bowel movements
One or more hard, tender lumps near the anus

records.definition_zh: 眩暈是指頭暈與目眩並見的病證：頭暈者自覺頭腦昏沉、如將暈厥；眩者視物旋轉、如坐舟車。症狀可持續或呈發作性，歷時數分鐘至數小時，常因體位變動而誘發；病情有輕重之分，輕者為輕度眩暈，重者為重度眩暈。
records.definition_en: Dizziness and vertigo is a condition combining two different feelings: lightheadedness, a feeling of being about to faint, and vertigo, a spinning sensation. Symptoms can be constant or episodic, last from minutes to hours, and onset can be triggered by a movement; it is categorized into mild vertigo and severe vertigo.
records.etiology_zh: 病因分外感與內傷兩類（外因與內因）。
records.etiology_en: The causes are classified into external causes and internal causes.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 其病機主要有五：肝陽上亢，上擾清竅；痰濁阻滯，清陽不升；瘀血內停，脈絡不通；氣血兩虛，清竅失養；腎精不足，髓海空虛。
records.pathomechanism_en: Five main mechanisms are described: liver yang uprising, phlegm obstruction, blood stagnation, qi and blood deficiency, and kidney essence insufficiency.

噁心或嘔吐
眼球運動異常
言語困難
行走困難
key_manifestations_en: A sensation of motion (spinning)
Nausea or vomiting
Abnormal eye movements
Difficulty speaking
Difficulty walking

records.definition_zh: 中風，古稱「猝然中風邪」之證，相當於西醫之腦血管意外（CVA），因腦部動脈阻塞或破裂，導致猝然昏仆、半身不遂（偏癱）等症的病證。
records.definition_en: Wind Stroke (Zhong Feng), a TCM term meaning "catching wind", corresponds to Cerebrovascular Accident (CVA), in which the arteries in the brain become blocked or rupture, resulting in hemiplegia.
records.etiology_zh: 一為肝陽亢盛、腎陰虧虛；二為痰濕內蘊；三為勞倦過度與情志緊張；四為生活方式失宜。
records.etiology_en: Its TCM etiology comprises: (1) liver yang excess with kidney yin deficiency; (2) phlegm and dampness accumulation; (3) overstrain and stress; (4) lifestyle factors.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 病機關鍵有五：風、火、痰、瘀、虛（虛包括血虛、陰虛、津液虧虛）。病位深淺分中經絡與中臟腑：中經絡者病輕，見風邪入中、肝腎陰虛化風、痰熱風痰上擾三種情形；中臟腑者病重，分閉證（實，陽閉、陰閉）與脫證（虛，陽脫、陰脫）；後遺恢復期則見肝腎陰虛、痰濕內蘊、氣血兩虛等傳變。
records.pathomechanism_en: Five key pathogenic factors operate: wind, fire, phlegm, stasis, and deficiency (of blood, yin, and body fluid). By depth, stroke refers to two types: meridian stroke (milder, with three conditions — wind invasion obstruction; liver and kidney yin deficiency stirring up wind; phlegm-heat with wind-phlegm disturbing upward) and zang-fu stroke (severe, divided into the excess/close type — yang bi and yin bi conditions — and the deficiency/open type — yang tuo and yin tuo conditions); in the convalescence stage it evolves into liver-kidney yin deficiency, damp-phlegm accumulation, or qi and blood deficiency.

神志喪失（昏仆）

嘔吐

records.definition_zh: 面癱（口僻，口眼喎斜）係外感風寒或風熱之邪侵襲面部經絡、絡脈及經筋所致，以口眼喎斜為主要表現的病證，相當於西醫之貝爾氏麻痺。任何年齡、任何時節皆可發病，以二十至四十歲多見，好發於春秋二季，女性較多。西醫對其病因尚不明確。
records.definition_en: Mian tan (deviation of eye and mouth, known in Chinese as kou yan wai xie) is derived from invasion of the meridians, collaterals and tendon-muscle meridians of the facial region by exogenous pathogenic wind-cold or wind-heat, manifesting as deviation of the eye and mouth; Bell's palsy is similar to this disorder. It can occur at any age and any time, but mostly at 20-40 years old, in spring and fall, and more frequently in females. In Western medicine the cause remains unknown.
records.etiology_zh: 面部經絡空虛於先，風寒或風熱之邪乘虛侵襲面部經絡經筋。西醫推測貝爾氏麻痺係免疫或病毒性疾病致面神經腫脹，面神經於顳骨內狹窄之骨管中受壓、缺血所致。
records.etiology_en: Deficiency or vacancy of the facial meridians, plus invasion of pathogenic wind-cold or wind-heat. Western medicine presumably thinks that Bell's palsy involves swelling of the nerve due to immune or viral disease, with ischemia and compression of the facial nerve in the narrow confines of its course through the temporal bone.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 面部經絡空虛，風寒風熱之邪入中，氣血阻滯，陽明、少陽經筋失於濡養，功能失司，面部肌肉筋脈癱緩不收，遂成口眼喎斜。病久遷延者，患側面肌攣縮，口角反牽向患側，是為「倒錯」。
records.pathomechanism_en: Facial meridian deficiency plus invasion of wind-cold or wind-heat leads to qi and blood stagnation, then malnutrition of the yangming and shaoyang tendon-muscle meridians, failure of their function, and paralysis of the facial muscles and sinews, producing deviation of eye and mouth. If the condition is prolonged, muscle contractures of the affected-side facial muscles may pull the mouth toward the affected side, which is called the 'inverted image'.
key_manifestations_zh: 起病突然，多於睡醒後發現，或先有耳後疼痛，癱瘓於數小時內進展，甚可完全
患側眼瞼閉合不全（瞼裂增寬）、口角下垂、鼻唇溝變淺、流涎
不能皺眉、抬眉、閉目、鼓腮、示齒或吹哨
口眼喎斜向健側，或舌前三分之二味覺消失，可伴聽覺過敏、乳突部疼痛或頭痛
患側面部平坦無表情，自覺僵硬、沉重、麻木、弛緩，但無可查之感覺缺失
key_manifestations_en: Sudden onset, often right after waking up, possibly preceded by pain behind the ear; weakness develops within hours, sometimes to complete paralysis
Incomplete closure of the eye on the affected side (widened palpebral fissure), drooping of the angle of the mouth, flattened nasolabial sulcus, salivation
Inability to frown, raise the eyebrow, close the eye, blow out the cheek, show the teeth or whistle
Deviation of eye and mouth to the healthy side; possible disappearance of taste in the front two-thirds of the tongue, with hyperacusis, mastoid-region pain or headache
Affected side flat and expressionless, feeling stiff, heavy, numb and flaccid, but no demonstrable sensory loss

records.definition_zh: 心悸是指患者自覺心中悸動不安、心跳異常的病證，可表現為心跳過速、心跳漏跳感或心中怦怦跳動，程度輕者常不自覺，重者則明顯可感；發作可見於活動或安靜之時，持續時間自數秒至數小時不等。
records.definition_en: Palpitation is a condition in which the patient subjectively perceives an abnormality in the normal beating of the heart, ranging from often unnoticed skipped beats or an accelerated heart rate to very noticeable changes; it can occur whether the patient is active or at rest, and episodes may last from a few seconds to several hours.
records.etiology_zh: 實證多因情志失調（精神因素）、痰濕內停、外邪乘心，或久病所致；虛證多因勞倦過度與久病耗傷而成。
records.etiology_en: Excess-type palpitation arises from emotional/mental disorder, accumulation of phlegm-damp, pathogenic factors invading the heart, or chronic disease; deficiency-type palpitation arises from overstrain and chronic disease.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 本病分虛實兩端：實者瘀血阻絡（心血瘀阻）、痰火擾心，或水飲上凌於心，心神被擾而悸動；虛者心之氣、血、陰、陽虧虛，心失所養，神不守舍而作悸。（講義未另立病機專節，此為其虛實分類與各證型內容之歸納。）
records.pathomechanism_en: The disease divides into excess and deficiency: in excess patterns, blood stasis obstructing the heart vessels, phlegm-fire harassing the heart, or pathogenic water attacking the heart disturbs the heart spirit and causes palpitation; in deficiency patterns, deficiency of heart qi, blood, yin, or yang leaves the heart undernourished and the spirit unsettled. (The handout has no separate pathomechanism section; this summarizes its excess/deficiency classification and pattern content.)

records.definition_zh: 鬱證乃情志失調所致之病證，以持續之悲傷、失落、憤怒、煩躁等情緒障礙為主要表現，妨礙日常生活達數週以上；相當於西醫之抑鬱障礙（憂鬱症），不僅見於成人，兒童與青少年亦可罹患，且常與經前綜合徵並見。
records.definition_en: Yu zheng (depressive disorder) is a mood disorder in which feelings of sadness, loss, anger, or frustration interfere with daily life for weeks or longer; it occurs not only in adults but also in children and teens, and often occurs with PMS.
records.etiology_zh: 中醫病因為：一、肝氣鬱結；二、心陰虧虛；三、痰濕內擾。西醫確切病因不明，一般認為與腦內化學物質改變有關，可因遺傳因素或應激事件誘發，或兩者兼有；可能之誘因尚包括遺傳、酗酒、藥物濫用、睡眠障礙、精神壓力、某些藥物及某些內科疾病。
records.etiology_en: TCM etiology: (1) liver qi stagnation; (2) heart yin deficiency; (3) damp-phlegm disturbances. In Western medicine the exact cause is unknown; it is believed to involve chemical changes in the brain, due to a problem with the genes or triggered by stressful events, or both — possible causes include heredity, alcohol, drug abuse, sleeping disorder, stress, certain medications and certain medical conditions.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 本病病機以實證與虛證分列。實者肝氣鬱結，氣機不暢，胸脅脹悶疼痛；氣滯日久則血行瘀阻而成血瘀；鬱久化火則肝火上炎，兼犯胃腑；氣鬱津凝，聚而成痰，痰氣互結則咽中如有物梗；氣鬱擾心則心神不寧。虛者病久耗傷，心脾兩虛、心陰虧虛、肝陰不足，甚則脾腎陽虛，神失所養而抑鬱纏綿。
records.pathomechanism_en: The handout organizes the pathomechanism into excess and deficiency conditions. In excess, liver qi stagnation obstructs the qi dynamic with distention, stuffiness and pain of the chest and hypochondria; prolonged qi stagnation leads to blood stasis; stagnation transforming into fire gives liver fire uprising that also disturbs stomach function; qi stagnation with phlegm accumulation produces the sensation of an object in the throat that can be neither expectorated nor swallowed; disturbance of the heart shen causes emotional instability. In deficiency, prolonged illness leads to heart and spleen deficiency, heart yin deficiency, liver yin deficiency, and ultimately spleen and kidney yang deficiency, leaving the shen malnourished.

煩躁不安，易於激動發怒
自覺孤立無援，絕望、無助、無價值感，自責自罪
對既往喜好之活動喪失興趣或樂趣
疲乏，睡眠差，注意力不集中，性慾減退
食慾驟變、體重改變，甚則自傷或有自殺意念

Loss of interest or pleasure in activities that were once enjoyed
Fatigue, poor sleeping, poor concentration, poor sexual drive
Sudden change in appetite, weight changes, and in severe cases hurting themselves or thoughts of suicide

records.definition_zh: 虛勞（慢性疲勞綜合徵）指以嚴重而持續之疲倦為特徵的一組症候，其疲倦休息不能緩解，非其他疾病直接引起，病程持續六個月以上。
records.definition_en: Xu lao (chronic fatigue syndrome) refers to a group of symptoms characterized by severe continued tiredness that is not relieved by rest, is not directly caused by other medical conditions, and lasts more than six months.
records.etiology_zh: 西醫對本病之機理尚未明瞭，一般認為與EB病毒或人類疱疹病毒六型（HHV-6）感染，以及免疫應答失常所致之神經系統炎症有關。中醫則責之餘邪未淨（外感之後餘邪留戀），以及臟腑氣血陰陽虧虛。
records.etiology_en: In Western medicine this syndrome is not clearly understood; it is believed to be due to Epstein-Barr virus or human herpes virus-6 (HHV-6), and inflammation in the nervous system because of a faulty immune system response. In Chinese medicine it is attributed to residual pathogenic factors after an external invasion (residual EPI) and to deficiency of the zang-fu organs' qi, blood, yin and yang.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 外感之後餘邪未淨：邪留少陽而成少陽證；邪入陽明化熱，上焦則為心熱、肺熱，中焦則發熱心煩，下焦則熱灼傷陰。脾為濕熱所困而脾氣虛；肺之水液下歸於脾而肺氣虛；肝氣橫逆乘脾，肝鬱而脾氣益虛。病久則諸臟虛損：肝血虛、肺陰虛、胃陰虛、腎陰虛、腎陽虛、心血虛、心陰虛，虛勞遂成。
records.pathomechanism_en: After an external invasion the residual pathogen lingers: retained in shaoyang it forms a shaoyang pattern; entering yangming it transforms into heat — heat in the upper jiao as heart heat and lung heat, heat in the middle jiao with fever and irritability, and heat in the lower jiao that hurts yin. Spleen damp-heat encumbers the spleen causing spleen qi deficiency; lung fluid falls back to the spleen with lung qi deficiency; liver qi overacts on the spleen, giving liver qi stagnation with spleen qi deficiency. With prolonged illness the organs become depleted: liver blood, lung yin, stomach yin, kidney yin, kidney yang, heart blood and heart yin deficiency.
key_manifestations_zh: 持續疲乏，臥床休息亦不能緩解
肌肉痠痛無力，關節疼痛而無紅腫
失眠，健忘，注意力不集中，神識昏蒙
咽痛，淋巴結腫大，低熱，免疫力低下
與既往不同之頭痛，肩部肌肉緊繃疼痛，胸痛或胸悶
腸易激，腹瀉

Muscle aches and weak muscles; joint pain but no swelling or redness
Insomnia, forgetfulness, poor concentration, confusion
Sore throat, enlargement of lymph nodes, low-grade fever, weak immunity
Headache that differs from the past, tight and painful shoulder muscles, chest pain or congestion
IBS, diarrhea

records.definition_zh: 淋證係以小便頻數急迫、短少澀滯、淋瀝刺痛、排尿困難為主症的病證，多伴小腹拘急或痛引腰腹。約當西醫之尿路感染、膀胱炎、泌尿系結石、前列腺炎、腎小球腎炎、乳糜尿、尿瀦留及膀胱腫瘤等疾患。
records.definition_en: Lin syndrome is a disorder characterized by discomfort during urination, with urgency, increased frequency, oliguria, and painful, difficult urination, often with lower abdominal cramping or pain radiating to the lower back. It roughly corresponds to Western conditions such as urinary tract infection, cystitis, urinary calculi, prostatitis, glomerulonephritis, milky urine, urinary retention, and neoplasms of the bladder or prostate.
records.etiology_zh: 飲食不節，脾生濕濁，釀成內生濕熱；外感濕熱之邪侵犯膀胱；熱邪或濕熱傷及血分；濕熱擾亂膀胱氣化；年老或久病致腎氣虛；脾腎兩虛；情志不遂，肝氣鬱結。
records.etiology_en: Improper diet generating internal damp-heat from spleen dampness; exogenous damp-heat invading the urinary bladder; heat or damp-heat injuring the blood; damp-heat disturbing the bladder's function of qi transformation; old age or chronic illness causing kidney qi deficiency; deficiency of spleen and kidney; emotional stress stagnating liver qi.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 病位主在膀胱與腎，並涉及脾、肝。基本病機為濕熱、濕寒等病邪阻滯水道，膀胱、腎之氣化失司；或兼氣虛、陰虛不能司膀胱開闔。濕熱蘊結下焦煎熬成石則為石淋；肝氣鬱滯、氣機不利則為氣淋；熱傷血絡則為血淋；濕濁不化則為膏淋；久病耗傷氣血陰精，脾腎虛憊，病情纏綿反覆，則轉為勞淋。實證多急，虛證多慢性反覆。
records.pathomechanism_en: The disease is located mainly in the bladder and kidney, involving the spleen and liver. The key pathology is obstruction of the water passages by pathogenic factors, most often damp-heat or damp-cold, impairing bladder and kidney qi transformation, with possible underlying deficiency of qi or yin that fails to regulate urination. Damp-heat condensing in the lower burner produces stones (stone lin); liver qi stagnation obstructing the water passages produces qi lin; heat injuring the collaterals produces blood lin; unresolved damp turbidity produces cloudy lin; chronic depletion of qi, blood, or yin with spleen-kidney deficiency produces recurrent, lingering fatigue lin. Excess patterns are acute; deficiency patterns are chronic and recurrent.

隨證型不同可兼見尿中砂石、血尿或小便渾濁如膏

Depending on the type, sand or stones in the urine, hematuria, or cloudy, milky urine

records.definition_zh: 遺尿（尿床）指三歲以上小兒於睡眠中不自主排尿的病證，即在無意識之睡眠狀態下尿液不自主漏出，多見於幼童。中醫認為本病與肺、脾、腎及膀胱相關。
records.definition_en: Yi niao (nocturnal enuresis, bedwetting) refers to urination during sleep in children over three years old — accidental urine leakage while in an unconscious condition during sleeping, usually related to young children. In TCM, enuresis is associated with the lung, spleen, kidney and urinary bladder.
records.etiology_zh: 素體虛弱，腎氣不足，肺脾氣虛。此外尚有久病體衰、胎兒或小兒發育期間受驚、年老生理機能衰退、房勞過度耗傷腎精、產育耗損精氣、久咳不已等因素。
records.etiology_en: Weak constitution, kidney qi deficiency, and lung qi and spleen qi deficiency. Additional contributing factors include long-term debilitating disease, shock to the developing child or fetus, physiological change of old age, excessive sexual activity causing kidney essence deficiency, childbirth using up essence, and chronic cough with the repeated act of coughing.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 虛者為主：腎陽虛衰、下焦虛寒，膀胱失於約束；腎陰虧虛，膀胱失司則尿後餘瀝；脾氣虛而下陷、肺氣虛弱，上虛不能制下，咳嗽噴嚏之際尿液外漏。實者為次：肝火內擾、心火亢盛，擾動心神則夜寐不安而遺尿；濕熱下注膀胱，膀胱失約則遺尿且小便灼熱不利。
records.pathomechanism_en: Deficiency types predominate: kidney yang deficiency with lower jiao cold and deficiency leaves the bladder unrestrained; kidney yin deficiency causes dribbling after urination with reduced force; spleen qi deficiency or sinking and lung qi deficiency mean the upper cannot control the lower, with leakage on coughing or sneezing. Excess types: liver fire and heart fire disturb the spirit, causing restless sleep and enuresis; damp-heat pouring down into the urinary bladder deprives it of restraint, with burning, difficult urination.
key_manifestations_zh: 睡眠中不自主排尿（尿床）
尿頻、夜尿，或尿後餘瀝不盡
兼氣虛者疲乏、納差、便溏、聲低息弱、自汗，咳嗽噴嚏時少量漏尿
兼火擾者夜寐不安、多夢、夜間齘齒或哭鬧
兼濕熱者小便困難、尿時灼熱
key_manifestations_en: Involuntary urination during sleep (bedwetting)
Frequent urination, nocturia, or dribbling after urination
With qi deficiency: fatigue, poor appetite, loose stool, soft weak voice, spontaneous sweat, slight leakage on coughing or sneezing
With fire disturbance: restless sleep, nightmares, teeth grinding or crying at night
With damp-heat: difficult urination, burning urination

records.definition_zh: 陽痿係指男子未逾八八天癸之年，陰莖持續痿軟不舉，或舉而不堅，不能完成正常房事的病證，即西醫之勃起功能障礙。中醫又稱陰痿、筋痿。
records.definition_en: Yang wei (impotence) refers to the male sexual dysfunction, occurring in men who have not yet passed the age of eight-times-eight of Tian Gui, characterized by the persistent inability to develop or maintain an erection of the penis satisfactory for sexual performance; it corresponds to erectile dysfunction (ED) in Western medicine. Alternative TCM names include yin wei and jin wei.
records.etiology_zh: 先天稟賦不足；命門火衰；心脾兩虛；情志所傷（肝氣鬱結，或恐懼傷腎）；濕熱下注下焦；陰津虧虛；陰陽兩虛；痰濕阻滯；局部脈絡阻滯；寒滯肝經；氣滯血瘀。
records.etiology_en: Poor congenital constitution; ming men fire deficiency; heart and spleen deficiency; emotional injury (liver qi stagnation, or fear damaging the kidney); damp-heat invading the lower jiao; yin fluid deficiency; combined yin and yang deficiency; phlegm-damp blockage; local blockage; cold invading the liver meridian; qi stagnation with blood stasis.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 講義未設專門病機論述，據其分型可知：或因先天不足、命門火衰、心脾氣血虧虛、陰津不足，宗筋失於溫煦濡養；或因濕熱、痰濕、寒邪、氣滯血瘀阻滯肝經與局部脈絡，宗筋弛縱不用而痿。
records.pathomechanism_en: The handout has no dedicated pathomechanism discussion; from its clinical classification, the disorder arises either from deficiency — poor congenital constitution, ming men fire deficiency, heart-spleen deficiency, or yin fluid deficiency depriving the ancestral sinew of warmth and nourishment — or from excess — damp-heat, phlegm-damp, cold in the liver meridian, or qi stagnation with blood stasis obstructing the channels locally — so that the ancestral sinew becomes slack and fails to rise.
key_manifestations_zh: 陰莖痿軟不能勃起，或舉而不堅
腰痠膝軟、乏力、畏寒、頭暈耳鳴（命門火衰者）
心悸、氣短、自汗、納差、便溏（心脾兩虛者）
小便灼熱、陰部潮濕瘙癢、口渴（濕熱下注者）
陰部發涼、少腹掣痛、小便清長（寒滯肝經者）
key_manifestations_en: Inability to develop or maintain an erection of the penis
Sore lower back, weak knees, fatigue, aversion to cold, dizziness, and tinnitus (ming men fire deficiency)
Palpitations, shortness of breath, spontaneous sweating, poor appetite, and loose stools (heart-spleen deficiency)
Burning urination, itchy and damp genitals, and thirst (damp-heat invading the lower jiao)
Cold genital area, pulling pain toward the lower abdomen, and profuse urination (cold invading the liver meridian)

records.definition_zh: 腰痛係指腰部一側、兩側或正中疼痛之病證，首載於《黃帝內經·素問》第四十一篇。腰痛可見於腎臟、婦科、脊柱及腰部筋肉等多種疾病；腰為腎之府，故腰痛與腎之關係最為密切。
records.definition_en: Lower back pain (yao tong) is first mentioned in the Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic (Huang Di Nei Jing, Su Wen), Chapter 41. It can occur unilaterally, bilaterally, or centrally, and is present in many diseases such as those of the kidneys, gynecology, the spinal column, and the lumbar muscles. TCM holds that the lower back region is the residence of the Kidneys, thus lower back pain has a close relationship with the Kidneys.
records.etiology_zh: 病涉腎、肝與督脈、膀胱經、帶脈。實證：外感寒濕或濕熱之邪，或勞損外傷（扭挫傷），致氣血瘀滯於經絡；虛證：稟賦不足、年老體衰、久病耗損，致精血虧耗、腎精衰減。
records.etiology_en: The Kidneys, Liver, Du vessel, Bladder channel, and Dai vessel are involved. Excess (shi): contraction of external pathogenic influences — invasion of cold-damp or damp-heat — or overexertion and trauma (sprain/contusion), leading to qi and blood stagnation in the meridians and collaterals. Deficiency (xu): constitutional weakness, old age, or chronic illness, leading to exhaustion and weakening of essence and blood and a decline of Kidney essence.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 實者，寒濕、濕熱之邪客於經絡，或跌仆勞損，氣血瘀滯，經脈不通則痛；虛者，精血虧耗，腎精衰減，經絡失於濡養，不榮則痛。臨證分寒濕、濕熱、瘀血、腎虛四型。
records.pathomechanism_en: In excess types, cold-damp or damp-heat lodges in the meridians, or overexertion and trauma cause qi and blood to stagnate, obstructing the channels and producing pain; in deficiency types, essence and blood are exhausted, Kidney essence declines, and the meridians and collaterals are deprived of nourishment, producing pain. Clinically it is differentiated into four types: cold-damp, damp-heat, blood stagnation, and Kidney deficiency.
key_manifestations_zh: 寒濕型：腰部冷痛重著，如有物下墜，晨起下床或陰雨天加重，轉側不利，舌苔白膩，脈沉
濕熱型：腰痛而有熱感，口苦心煩，小便短赤，舌苔黃膩，脈濡數
瘀血型：腰痛日久，痛如錐刺，或有外傷史，痛處固定，拒按，轉側不利，舌紫黯或有瘀點，脈澀
腎虛型：腰痛隱隱，痠軟無力，腿膝乏力，時作時止，勞則加重，兼見頭暈目眩、耳鳴、遺精，舌苔薄，脈沉細，尺部尤甚
key_manifestations_en: Cold-damp: cold lower back pain with a heavy dragging sensation, worse when getting up from bed or on rainy days, difficulty moving the back, white sticky tongue coating, deep pulse
Damp-heat: lower back pain with a sensation of heat, bitter taste in the mouth, restlessness, scanty deep-yellow urine, yellow sticky tongue coating, soft and rapid pulse
Blood stagnation: long-standing sharp pain or a history of trauma, fixed in location, worse on pressure, difficulty moving the back, purplish tongue or purple spots, hesitant pulse

Kidney deficiency: dull pain, sore and weak in nature, weakness of the legs, comes and goes, aggravated on exertion, with dizziness, blurred vision, tinnitus, nocturnal emission, thin tongue coating, thready deep pulse pronounced at the chi positions

records.definition_zh: 痺證於本講義以纖維肌痛症為載體講授：屬全身廣泛性疼痛、僵硬之病證。其痹證型以惡寒、惡陰雨天氣、肢體麻木、自覺手指足趾腫脹為特徵；局部無紅、腫、熱，關節活動度不受限。
records.definition_en: Bi syndrome is taught in this handout through fibromyalgia: a condition of widespread body pain and stiffness. Its Bi-syndrome type is characterized by aversion to cold and rainy weather, numbness of the limbs, and a frequent complaint of swollen fingers and toes; there is no local redness, swelling or heat, and no limitation of range of motion.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 講義未直接論述中醫病機；由其治療原則（促進局部血液循環、消散水濕、去除阻滯、補益氣血、止痛）可見其機轉為局部氣血阻滯、水濕停聚，部分患者兼有氣血不足。
records.pathomechanism_en: The handout does not state the TCM pathomechanism directly; from its stated treatment principles (promote local blood circulation, disperse fluids, remove blockage, tonify qi and blood, stop pain), the mechanism is local obstruction of qi and blood with retained fluids, with concurrent qi and blood deficiency in some patients.
key_manifestations_zh: 全身廣泛性疼痛與僵硬，特定壓痛點按壓（4公斤力）即劇痛
惡寒、惡陰雨天氣，對寒冷潮濕氣候高度敏感（痹證型）
肢體麻木，常自覺手指、足趾腫脹（痹證型）
局部無紅、腫、熱，關節活動度不受限，X光與檢驗均正常
舌體胖大、苔白膩；脈緊而滑（痹證型舌脈）
key_manifestations_en: Widespread pain and stiffness, with extreme pain on tender points under 4 kg of palpation force
Aversion to cold and rainy weather, with severe sensitivity to cold and damp conditions (Bi-syndrome type)
Numbness of the limbs, with frequent complaints of swollen fingers and toes (Bi-syndrome type)
No local redness, swelling or heat, no limitation of range of motion, and normal X-ray and laboratory findings
Big tongue body with a white, greasy coating; tight and slippery pulse (tongue and pulse of the Bi-syndrome type)

records.definition_zh: 痿證為以肢體軟弱無力、甚則癱瘓不用、肌肉萎縮為主要表現的病證，病位與肺、脾、腎、肝相關。西醫之多發性硬化症（Multiple Sclerosis）在中醫屬痿證範疇。
records.definition_en: Wei syndrome (atrophy-flaccidity syndrome) is a disorder characterized by limb weakness and flaccidity, in severe cases paralysis and muscular atrophy; it is associated with the lung, spleen, kidney and liver. In Chinese medicine, multiple sclerosis falls into the category of Wei syndrome.
records.etiology_zh: 一、外邪侵襲：以濕邪侵襲最為常見；亦可因風熱（伴高熱之強烈風熱型）而發。二、飲食不節：過食生濕之品及發物。三、房勞過度：耗傷腎精。四、驚恐及劇烈情志刺激：以心、脾受損最重。
records.etiology_en: 1. Invasion of external pathogens: damp invasion is the most common cause; a strong type of wind-heat with high fever may also be responsible. 2. Diet: damp-producing foods and excessive consumption of Fa Wu (stimulating foods). 3. Excessive sexual activity, which depletes the kidney. 4. Shock and severe emotions, with the heart and spleen taking the greatest hit.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 本病與肺、脾、腎、肝有關。其機轉可見：痰熱阻滯經絡（熱後突發肢體無力、麻木或癱瘓）；濕熱浸淫（肢體無力漸起，以下肢為著）；瘀血阻於經絡（肢體無力伴麻木、刺痛或攣痛，肌肉萎縮）；肺脾兩虛（肢體無力緩慢進展，伴肌肉萎縮）；肝腎虧虛（全身癱瘓、消瘦、腰膝痠軟，見陰虛內熱之象）；腎陽衰憊（全身癱瘓、肢冷畏寒、二便失司）。
records.pathomechanism_en: The disease involves the lung, spleen, kidney and liver. Its mechanisms include: obstruction of the meridians by phlegm and heat (sudden limb weakness, numbness or paralysis after fever); damp-heat dissemination (gradual limb weakness, most obvious in the lower limbs); blood stasis accumulated in the meridians (limb weakness with numbness, tingling or contracting pain and muscular atrophy); deficiencies of lung and spleen (slow, progressive limb weakness with atrophy); deficiencies of liver and kidney (general paralysis, weight loss, lumbar and knee soreness with signs of deficiency heat); and depletion of kidney yang (general paralysis with cold limbs, cold intolerance and impaired urination and bowel function).
key_manifestations_zh: 肢體軟弱無力，甚則癱瘓，以下肢為著
肌肉萎縮
肢體麻木、刺痛或攣痛
步態不穩、震顫、動作笨拙
視物模糊、複視，甚則失明
小便困難或失禁等二便功能障礙
key_manifestations_en: Limb weakness, in severe cases paralysis, most obvious in the lower limbs
Muscular atrophy
Numbness, tingling or contracting pain of the limbs
Unsteady gait, tremor and clumsiness
Blurred vision, double vision, or even blindness
Urinary difficulty or incontinence and other disorders of excretory function

records.definition_zh: 落枕指因睡眠姿勢不當，或風寒之邪侵襲頸項，導致所涉經脈局部氣機運行失調而發的急性頸項強痛（斜頸），多見於成年人。
records.definition_en: Luo zhen (stiff neck, wryneck / torticollis) refers to acute stiffness and pain of the neck caused by an inappropriate sleeping posture or an attack of wind-cold on the neck and nape, leading to disturbance of the local circulation of qi in the involved meridians; it occurs mostly in adults.
records.etiology_zh: 睡眠姿勢不當；風寒之邪侵襲頸項。
records.etiology_en: Inappropriate sleeping posture; invasion of the neck and nape by wind-cold.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 睡姿不當或風寒外襲，擾亂頸項部所涉經脈之局部氣機，氣血運行阻滯，筋脈拘急而見強直疼痛；故治以祛風散寒、舒筋活血、溫通經脈、去除阻滯。
records.pathomechanism_en: Poor sleeping posture or external wind-cold disturbs the local circulation of qi in the meridians traversing the neck; qi and blood become obstructed and the sinews cramp, producing stiffness and pain — hence the treatment principle of expelling wind and dispersing cold, relaxing the sinews, activating blood and qi circulation, warming the meridians and removing stagnation.
key_manifestations_zh: 一側頸項強直疼痛，頭歪向一側、活動受限；患者常保持頭偏向患側以減輕疼痛與痙攣
強直疼痛可放散至患側肩臂，偶爾頸項與肩部雙側同時受累
觸診頸項部有壓痛與肌肉痙攣，但無紅、熱、腫
或兼見風寒表證
若經治療疼痛強直仍逾一週不解，應轉介西醫評估頸椎疾患
key_manifestations_en: Stiffness and pain of the neck and nape on one side, with the head wried toward one side and motor impairment; most patients keep the head toward the affected side to reduce pain and spasm
Stiffness and pain may spread to the shoulder and arm on the affected side; occasionally both sides of the nape and shoulder are involved
Palpation shows tenderness and muscular spasm in the neck and nape area, but no redness, heat or swelling
Wind-cold symptoms may accompany the neck stiffness and pain
If pain and stiffness persist beyond a week despite treatment, refer to a physician to evaluate for cervical vertebrae disorders

records.definition_zh: 肩凝症（漏肩風），即凍結肩；因多發於五十歲左右之人，中醫又稱「五十肩」。相當於西醫之肩關節周圍炎，以肩部疼痛與各方向活動受限為特徵。
records.definition_en: Jian ning (frozen shoulder, also called 'leaking shoulder wind'), known in TCM as the 'fifty-year-old shoulder' because it usually occurs in people around their fifties; in Western medicine it corresponds to periarthritis of the shoulder joint, characterized by shoulder pain and limitation of motion in all directions.
records.etiology_zh: 腎虛（組織退化）；勞倦耗傷之際感受風寒濕邪，致肩部氣血凝滯；肩關節周圍組織損傷；睡中氣虛受邪；缺乏運動。
records.etiology_en: Kidney deficiency (degeneration); exhaustion with subsequent attack by wind-cold-damp, leading to qi and blood stagnation at the shoulder; injury to the tissues around the shoulder joint; qi deficiency while asleep; lack of exercise.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 腎虛則筋骨組織退化；勞倦氣虛之時風寒濕邪乘襲肩部，氣血凝滯不通而作痛。其病程具三個特點：初期以疼痛為主；後期因肩周粘連而以活動受限為主；最終因患肩少動、不動而肩臂肌肉萎縮。
records.pathomechanism_en: Kidney deficiency underlies tissue degeneration; when the body is exhausted, wind-cold-damp attacks the shoulder and qi and blood stagnate there, producing pain. The course has three characteristics: at the initial stage pain predominates; at the late stage limitation of range of motion predominates due to adhesion around the shoulder; finally the affected shoulder and arm become atrophic from lack of motion.
key_manifestations_zh: 初起患側肩部輕度酸楚或疼痛（常被忽視），活動與勞累後逐漸加重
疼痛漸進加劇並擴散至鄰近組織——上及頸項、下至上臂、後及項背肩胛部，但患處無紅、熱、腫
肩周疼痛夜間加重，甚至痛醒；白天活動後疼痛減輕
重者肩關節各方向活動均受限，以致穿脫衣、梳頭困難
肩周可捫及壓痛點（如LI 15等處）
慢性病例可見患側三角肌萎縮
key_manifestations_en: Initially mild soreness or pain (usually negligible) on one side of the shoulder with movements, gradually becoming pronounced and worse on exertion

Pain aggravates progressively and spreads to nearby tissues — up to the neck, down to the upper arm, and back to the nape and scapular area — yet with no redness, heat or swelling in the affected area
Pain around the shoulder is worse at night, even waking the patient, and is alleviated by exercise during the day
In severe cases movement of the affected shoulder is limited in all directions, preventing the patient from dressing and undressing or combing the hair
Tender points around the shoulder (such as LI 15) can be palpated
Atrophy of the deltoid muscle on the diseased side is present in chronic cases

records.definition_en: Dysmenorrhea refers to severe, frequent cramping pain in the lower abdomen and lower back occurring either before, during, or after the menstrual cycle.
records.etiology_zh: 情志刺激；外邪侵襲；氣血瘀滯；衝任損傷。
records.etiology_en: Emotional stimulation; invasion of exogenous factors; qi and blood stagnation; damage to the Chong and Ren vessels.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 經前或經期作痛者屬實，多因肝氣鬱滯、寒邪侵襲凝滯，或衝任受損，氣血運行不暢，不通則痛；經後作痛、痛勢隱隱者屬虛，多因氣虛、血虛或氣血兩虛，胞宮失於濡養，不榮則痛。
records.pathomechanism_en: Pain preceding or during menstruation indicates an excess pattern, mostly from liver qi stagnation, cold invasion, or damage to the Chong and Ren vessels obstructing the movement of qi and blood — where there is blockage there is pain. Dull pain following menstruation indicates a deficiency pattern, from insufficiency of qi, blood, or both, failing to nourish — where there is lack of nourishment there is pain.
key_manifestations_zh: 經期前後或行經時小腹劇烈痙攣性疼痛
疼痛可連及腰部
實證者疼痛多見於經前或經期
虛證者多於經末或經後隱隱作痛
key_manifestations_en: Severe cramping pain in the lower abdomen before, during, or after menstruation
Pain may extend to the lower back
In excess types, pain precedes or occurs during menstruation
In deficiency types, dull pain usually starts by the end of or after menstruation

records.definition_zh: 月經先期指月經較應至之期提前七至八日而至，甚或一月兩至者。
records.definition_en: Early menstruation refers to menstruation arriving earlier than the due time by 7 to 8 days, or even occurring twice a month.
records.etiology_zh: 血熱；氣虛。
records.etiology_en: Heat in the blood; qi deficiency.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 本病與足三陰經及衝、任二脈相關；血熱者屬實，氣虛者屬虛（治療上實者用瀉法，虛者用補法並灸）。（講義僅列病因與虛實分型，未詳述病機）
records.pathomechanism_en: The disorder involves the Three Foot Yin channels as well as the Chong and Ren channels; heat in the blood is an excess type, while qi deficiency is a deficient type (treated respectively with reducing techniques, and tonifying techniques with moxibustion). (The handout lists causes and excess/deficiency typing only, without elaborating the mechanism.)
key_manifestations_zh: 月經週期提前七至八日

key_manifestations_en: Menstrual cycle arrives 7 to 8 days earlier than the due time
In severe cases menstruation occurs twice in one month

records.definition_zh: 月經後期指月經較應至之期延後八至九日而至，甚或四五十日一行者。
records.definition_en: Late menstruation refers to menstruation arriving later than the due time by 8 to 9 days, or even occurring only every 40 to 50 days.
records.etiology_zh: 血虛；血寒；氣滯。
records.etiology_en: Blood deficiency; cold in the blood; qi stagnation.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 本病與足三陰經及衝、任二脈相關；分血虛、血寒、氣滯三端，虛者（血虛、血寒兼腎陽虛者）用補法並灸，實者（氣滯）用瀉法。（講義僅列病因與分型，未詳述病機）
records.pathomechanism_en: The disorder involves the Three Foot Yin channels as well as the Chong and Ren channels; it divides into blood deficiency, cold in the blood, and qi stagnation. Deficient types (blood deficiency, and cold with kidney yang deficiency) are treated with tonifying techniques and moxibustion, while the excess type (qi stagnation) is treated with reducing techniques. (The handout lists causes and typing only, without elaborating the mechanism.)
key_manifestations_zh: 月經週期延後八至九日
甚或四五十日一行
血寒者可兼小腹冷痛
氣滯者可兼乳房脹痛、情志不舒
key_manifestations_en: Menstrual cycle arrives 8 to 9 days later than the due time
In severe cases menstruation occurs only every 40 to 50 days
In the cold-in-the-blood type there may be cold pain (of the lower abdomen)
In the qi-stagnation type there may be breast tenderness and emotional stress

records.definition_zh: 崩漏指經期之外的子宮出血，或量多如注，或淋漓不斷。崩者，驟然而至、出血量多；漏者，起病隱緩、出血量少。
records.definition_en: Uterine bleeding beyond the menstrual period, either copious or continuously spotting, is generally defined as Beng Lou in TCM. Beng means sudden onset with profuse bleeding; Lou means insidious onset with scanty bleeding.
records.etiology_zh: 中醫將崩漏歸因於三端：一為實熱，如心熱損傷衝任，或陰虛致心肝失養、虛火內生而灼於血海；二為氣虛，如脾虛不能統攝血行，或青春期、絕經期腎氣不足致衝任失養；三為衝任損傷、固攝陰血失職，如墮胎、小產、產後及手術損傷衝任，風寒侵襲胞宮致血瘀阻滯，情志刺激致肝氣鬱結、血行瘀滯而衝任阻塞。西醫學認為子宮出血的原因包括：激素失衡（最常見，有時因激素藥物使用不當）、子宮頸或宮腔息肉、子宮肌瘤、卵巢囊腫、使用宮內節育器、妊娠併發症（流產、先兆流產、異位妊娠）、子宮或卵巢或子宮頸癌，以及凝血障礙、糖尿病、甲狀腺疾病等慢性疾患。
records.etiology_en: TCM attributes Beng Lou to: (1) Excess heat — heart heat damaging the Chong and Ren, or Yin deficiency leading to lack of nourishment of the heart and liver, resulting in deficiency fire internally burning in the blood sea; (2) Qi deficiency — Spleen deficiency unable to control blood flow, or Kidney Qi deficiency during puberty or menopause leading to lack of nourishment of the Chong and Ren; (3) Chong and Ren damage with failure in controlling Yin blood — abortion, miscarriage, postpartum, and surgery injuring the Chong and Ren; wind-cold invasion of the uterus causing blood stagnation and blockage; and emotional stimulation causing liver Qi and blood stagnation that blocks the Chong and Ren. Western medicine attributes uterine bleeding to hormone imbalance (the most common cause, sometimes from improper use of hormone medicine), polyps on the cervix or inside the uterus, fibroids (noncancerous growths in the uterus), an ovarian cyst, use of an IUD, pregnancy complications (miscarriage, threat of miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy), cancer of the uterus, ovary, or cervix, and chronic medical disorders such as blood-clotting problems, diabetes, and thyroid problems.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 崩為急證，漏為緩證，二者在病程中常互相轉化：暴崩下血，耗傷氣血，可轉為淋漓不止之漏；久漏不止，氣虛失攝，又可復發為崩。熱迫、氣虛失統與衝任損傷失於固攝，皆使經血非時妄行。
records.pathomechanism_en: Although Beng is an acute and Lou a chronic condition, they often transform into each other in the course of the disease: profuse bleeding (Beng) consumes Qi and blood, leading to continuous scanty bleeding (Lou), while prolonged scanty bleeding (Lou) due to Qi deficiency can change into profuse bleeding (Beng). Excess heat, Qi deficiency failing to control blood, and Chong and Ren damage failing to restrain Yin blood all cause menstrual blood to flow outside its proper time.
key_manifestations_zh: 經期之外的子宮出血
崩者驟然而至，出血量多
漏者起病隱緩，淋漓量少
崩漏常互相轉化：崩久成漏，漏久復崩
key_manifestations_en: Uterine bleeding beyond the menstrual period
Beng: sudden onset and profuse bleeding
Lou: insidious onset and scanty spotting
Beng and Lou often transform into each other: profuse bleeding becomes continuous spotting, and prolonged spotting can change into profuse bleeding

records.definition_zh: 閉經指女子年逾十八歲月經尚未初潮（原發性閉經），或月經週期已建立之後停閉三個月以上、並伴見其他症狀（繼發性閉經）的病證；家族史有時可為診斷線索。
records.definition_en: Amenorrhea means not having menstrual periods. It refers to the condition in which a female has never menstruated by 18 years of age (primary amenorrhea), or in which an established menstrual cycle has been suspended for over 3 months in association with a number of other signs and symptoms (secondary amenorrhea). Family history may sometimes be a clue.
records.etiology_zh: 中醫認為本病之因有三：血滯、血枯與衝任損傷。西醫學認為原發性閉經主因青春期延遲，多原因不明，亦可由激素異常（如甲狀腺功能減退）、染色體異常等遺傳因素或先天缺陷（如無陰道、無子宮或陰道閉鎖）所致；繼發性閉經最常見於妊娠與哺乳，停用避孕藥後亦可延遲，其他原因包括情志刺激、腦外傷、垂體或卵巢及腎上腺腫瘤、卵巢囊腫、抑鬱、假孕、甲狀腺疾病、營養不良、劇烈運動、泌乳素分泌增多、鎮靜與抗抑鬱等藥物、體重驟增驟減、化學治療、慢性疾病（腎衰竭、囊性纖維化、結腸炎等）、盆腔放射治療、宮腔粘連（Asherman氏綜合徵）及重度吸菸等；長期身體壓力、消瘦（如厭食）或體脂過低者常見停經半年以上；絕經（可早於四十歲）及子宮切除後則為永久性閉經。
records.etiology_en: TCM attributes this disease to three causes: blood stagnation, blood exhaustion, and Chong and Ren damage. In Western medicine, the main cause of primary amenorrhea is late puberty, mostly for no known reason, sometimes from a hormonal problem such as hypothyroidism, a genetic disorder such as chromosome abnormalities, or a birth defect (e.g., absence of the vagina or uterus, or a vagina without an opening for menstrual blood to escape). The most common cause of secondary amenorrhea is pregnancy; breast-feeding mothers usually do not menstruate, and periods may take 3 months or longer to resume after stopping birth control pills or nursing. Secondary amenorrhea may also result from emotional stress, brain injury, tumors of the pituitary gland, ovary, or adrenal gland, ovarian cysts, depression, pseudocyesis, thyroid problems, malnutrition, vigorous exercise, increased prolactin production by the pituitary, drugs such as tranquilizers and antidepressants, rapid weight gain or loss, chemotherapy, chronic diseases such as kidney failure, cystic fibrosis, and colitis, pelvic radiotherapy, Asherman's syndrome (scarring of the uterine lining after infection or surgery such as a D&C), and heavy smoking. Long lapses of 6 months or longer are common with ongoing physical stress, marked weight loss (as with anorexia), or very low body fat (as in some female athletes). Permanent secondary amenorrhea occurs after menopause (which may occur prematurely before age 40) and after hysterectomy.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 病機分血滯、血枯與衝任損傷三端：血滯者瘀阻衝任，經血不得下行；血枯者精血耗竭，血海空虛，無血可下；衝任損傷者衝任二脈失於通盛，經水乃絕。其傳變常循月經後期、經量漸減而至經閉的過程；氣血瘀滯者治當通調衝任、祛除瘀滯，氣血虛竭者治當補益腎氣。
records.pathomechanism_en: The pathomechanism falls under blood stagnation, blood exhaustion, and Chong and Ren damage: with blood stagnation, stasis obstructs the Chong and Ren so menstrual blood cannot descend; with blood exhaustion, blood is depleted and the blood sea is empty, leaving no blood to discharge; with Chong and Ren damage, these two vessels fail and menstruation ceases. The typical progression is late menses, then decrease of menstrual flow, then amenorrhea. Treatment clears the stagnation from Chong and Ren for the Qi and blood stagnation type, and tonifies kidney Qi for the Qi and blood exhaustion type.
key_manifestations_zh: 年逾十八歲月經尚未初潮（原發性閉經）
月經停閉三個月以上，並伴其他症狀（繼發性閉經）
常先見月經後期、經量漸少，繼而經閉不行
兼症隨病因而異：激素失衡者可見體毛及面毛增多、痤瘡、乳汁自出、聲音或性慾改變、體重增減等
key_manifestations_en: No menstruation by 18 years of age (primary amenorrhea)
Menstrual cycle suspended for over 3 months, with a number of other signs and symptoms (secondary amenorrhea)
Typical progression of late menses, then decrease of menstrual flow, then amenorrhea
Other symptoms depend on the cause: with hormone imbalance there may be excessive body and facial hair, acne, breast milk secretions, a change in voice or sex drive, and weight gain or loss

records.definition_zh: 帶下病指以陰道黏液樣分泌物持續過多為特徵的疾病，中醫稱之為帶下。西醫學中相當於累及陰道黏膜、有時波及外陰的感染性及其他炎症性疾患，常產生異常陰道分泌物。
records.definition_en: Leukorrhagia refers to a disease characterized by persistent excessive mucous vaginal discharge; it is called Dai Xia in TCM. In Western medicine it corresponds to infections and other inflammatory disorders affecting the vaginal mucosa and sometimes the vulva, commonly producing an abnormal vaginal discharge.
records.etiology_zh: 病因包括：飲食不節；腎氣虛而帶脈弛縱失約；肝氣鬱結日久。臨證應詳詢病史，包括帶下之色、質、氣味與持續時間，是否與月經相關、是否反覆發作，有無瘙癢、灼熱、疼痛或局部病損，並問及性生活史（避孕方式與性傳播疾病）、尿道分泌物、瘙癢、交合後刺激、陰道感染史及家中他人有無陰部瘙癢等。
records.etiology_en: Causes include improper diet; kidney Qi deficiency with a loose Dai Mai; and long-standing Liver Qi stagnation. A complete history should be taken, including symptoms and the color, consistency, odor, and duration of the discharge; whether it occurs in relation to menses and whether it is recurrent; whether itching, burning, pain, or a lesion is present; and what bothers the patient the most. A sexual history (contraceptive use and STDs), as well as questions about urethral discharge, pruritus, postcoital irritation, vaginal infection, and whether anyone else in the household has genital itching, are pertinent.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 腎氣虛則帶脈弛縱、約束無力，飲食不節與肝鬱日久皆可致濕濁下注而為帶下。臨床上帶下清稀、色白者，多屬寒濕；帶下稠黏、色黃（或黃白相兼）而有臭味者，多屬濕熱。治療以補脾、調理帶脈與衝任督脈、化濕或清熱為法。
records.pathomechanism_en: With kidney Qi deficiency the Dai Mai becomes loose and fails to restrain; improper diet and long-standing Liver Qi stagnation likewise lead to damp pouring downward as vaginal discharge. Clinically, dilute, clear, white leukorrhea usually accompanies cold damp, while thick, yellow (or white-yellow) leukorrhea with a foul smell is regarded as damp heat. Treatment is directed toward tonifying the Spleen, regulating the Dai, Chong, Ren, and Du channels, and transforming damp or clearing heat.
key_manifestations_zh: 帶下量多，持續不斷
寒濕者帶下清稀、色白
濕熱者帶下稠黏、色黃或黃白相兼、有臭味
或伴陰部瘙癢、灼熱、疼痛
key_manifestations_en: Persistent excessive mucous vaginal discharge
With cold damp, the leukorrhea is dilute, clear, and white
With damp heat, the leukorrhea is thick, yellow (or white-yellow), with a foul smell
There may be accompanying genital itching, burning, or pain

records.definition_zh: 不孕係指夫婦同居三年以上、配偶雙方身體健康而未能受孕者；或末次分娩之後三年以上不再受孕者。前者為原發性不孕，後者為繼發性不孕。
records.definition_en: Infertility refers to failure to conceive after more than three years of marriage even though both partners are healthy, or failure to conceive for more than three years after the last delivery.
records.etiology_zh: 腎虛；精血虧少、衝任不足；命門火衰；氣血瘀滯；痰濕阻滯。
records.etiology_en: Kidney deficiency; deficiency of blood, essence, and the Chong and Ren vessels; fading of the Mingmen fire; stagnation of qi and blood; blockage by damp and phlegm.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 腎虛則精血不足，衝任虛損，胞宮失養；命門火衰則胞宮虛寒，不能攝精成孕；氣血瘀滯或痰濕壅阻胞宮胞脈，兩精不得相合，故而不孕。臨證分為腎虛、血虛、宮寒、氣血痰瘀阻滯四型。
records.pathomechanism_en: Kidney deficiency leads to insufficiency of essence and blood and depletion of the Chong and Ren vessels, leaving the uterus unnourished; fading of the Mingmen fire leaves the uterus cold and unable to receive essence for conception; stagnation of qi and blood or obstruction by damp-phlegm blocks the uterus and its vessels so the two essences cannot unite. Clinically it is differentiated into four types: kidney deficiency, blood deficiency, cold uterus, and stagnation of qi, blood, or phlegm.
key_manifestations_zh: 婚後同居三年以上、配偶雙方健康而不受孕
末次分娩後三年以上不再受孕
依腎虛、血虛、宮寒或氣血痰瘀之不同證型而兼見相應全身見證
key_manifestations_en: No conception after more than three years of marriage although both partners are healthy
No conception for more than three years after the last delivery
Accompanying general signs vary with the type: kidney deficiency, blood deficiency, cold uterus, or stagnation of qi, blood, or phlegm

records.definition_zh: 男性不育指男性與具生育能力的女性在未避孕、規律性生活一年後，仍未能使其受孕。
records.definition_en: Male infertility refers to the inability of a male to achieve a pregnancy in a fertile female after one year of unprotected intercourse.
records.etiology_zh: 講義所列相關因素包括先天或染色體異常、年齡、肥胖、藥物、酒精、吸菸、長時間高強度騎乘、睪丸疾病或放射治療，以及感染、逆行射精、射精管阻塞、尿道下裂與陽痿等睪丸後因素。中醫辨證則涉及腎精不足、腎陽虛、腎陰虛、脾氣或氣血不足、氣血瘀滯、痰濕及下焦或肝經濕熱。
records.etiology_en: The handout lists congenital or chromosomal abnormalities, age, obesity, drugs and medications, alcohol, tobacco smoking, strenuous riding, testicular disease or radiation, and post-testicular factors such as infection, retrograde ejaculation, ejaculatory duct obstruction, hypospadias, and impotence. TCM patterns include Kidney Jing deficiency, Kidney Yang deficiency, Kidney Yin deficiency, Spleen Qi or Qi-Blood deficiency, Qi-Blood stagnation, Phlegm-Dampness, and Damp-Heat in the Lower Jiao or Liver channel.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 病位以腎為主。腎精、腎陽或腎陰虧虛，或脾氣及氣血不足，可使精液生成、精子成熟與活動力失常；氣血瘀滯、痰濕、下焦或肝經濕熱阻滯精道，則可影響精子活動、精液液化與形態。
records.pathomechanism_en: The main organ involved is the Kidney. Deficiency of Kidney Jing, Kidney Yang, or Kidney Yin, or deficiency of Spleen Qi and Qi-Blood, may impair semen production, sperm development, and motility. Qi-Blood stagnation, Phlegm-Dampness, and Damp-Heat in the Lower Jiao or Liver channel may obstruct the reproductive pathways and affect motility, liquefaction, and morphology.
key_manifestations_zh: 未避孕一年仍未能使具生育能力的女性受孕
少精子症
無精子症
精子活動力低下
精液液化不良
精子形態異常
key_manifestations_en: Failure to achieve pregnancy in a fertile female after one year of unprotected intercourse
Oligospermia
Azoospermia
Poor sperm motility
Poor semen liquefaction
Abnormal sperm morphology

無精子症或重度少精合併 FSH 升高、睪丸萎縮或疑似精子生成障礙：需作核型與 Y 染色體微缺失評估。
red_flags_en: Presumed male infertility or any abnormal semen parameter warrants evaluation by a male reproductive expert with complete history, physical examination, and directed testing as indicated.
Azoospermia or severe oligozoospermia with elevated FSH, testicular atrophy, or presumed impaired sperm production warrants karyotype and Y-chromosome microdeletion analysis.

records.definition_zh: 妊娠惡阻係指妊娠早期（多在妊娠前三個月內）出現噁心、嘔吐、厭食、頭暈等一組症狀者。為妊娠早期常見病證，通常於孕十二至十六週之間漸自緩解；重症稱妊娠劇吐（惡阻重症），可致孕婦形體消瘦，並變生他疾。
records.definition_en: Morning sickness is marked by a group of symptoms including nausea, vomiting, anorexia, and dizziness during early pregnancy, often within the first trimester of gestation. It is a common complaint in the early stage of pregnancy and usually subsides between weeks 12 and 16; severe cases are called hyperemesis gravidarum and may emaciate the pregnant woman and lead to other disorders.
records.etiology_zh: 脾胃虛弱，衝氣上逆；肝血不足，肝陽偏亢。
records.etiology_en: Deficiency of the Spleen and Stomach with rebellion of the Chong vessel qi; insufficiency of Liver blood with hyperactivity of Liver yang.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 脾胃素虛，孕後衝脈之氣上逆犯胃，胃失和降而嘔惡；肝血不足，肝陽偏亢，肝氣橫逆犯胃，肝胃不和亦致嘔逆。嘔吐不止，重則耗傷氣陰，形體消瘦，變生他疾。
records.pathomechanism_en: With pre-existing Spleen and Stomach deficiency, after conception the qi of the Chong vessel rebels upward and attacks the Stomach, which loses its harmonious descent, causing nausea and vomiting; when Liver blood is insufficient and Liver yang hyperactive, Liver qi invades the Stomach and the resulting Liver-Stomach disharmony likewise causes vomiting. Unrelenting vomiting in severe cases emaciates the pregnant woman and gives rise to other disorders.
key_manifestations_zh: 妊娠早期噁心嘔吐
厭食納呆
頭暈
重者嘔吐劇烈不止，形體消瘦（妊娠劇吐）
key_manifestations_en: Nausea and vomiting in early pregnancy
Anorexia
Dizziness
In severe cases unrelenting vomiting with emaciation (hyperemesis gravidarum)

records.definition_zh: 缺乳指產後哺乳期間乳汁分泌不足，不能滿足餵養嬰兒之需的常見臨床病證；甚者可全無乳汁分泌。
records.definition_en: Insufficient lactation refers to the common clinical condition in which the milk secretion of a nursing mother is insufficient to feed the baby; in some cases there may even be no milk secretion at all.
records.etiology_zh: 素體脾胃虛弱；失血過多；情志抑鬱。
records.etiology_en: Constitutional spleen and stomach deficiency; profuse loss of blood; mental depression.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 臨床分虛實兩端：虛者為氣血兩虛，實者為肝氣鬱結。故治療上虛證以補益氣血為主，實證以行氣活血通乳為主。（講義未再詳述病機）
records.pathomechanism_en: Clinically the disorder divides into deficiency and excess: the deficiency (xu) type is qi and blood deficiency, and the excess (shi) type is liver qi stagnation. Accordingly, treatment tonifies qi and blood for the xu type and moves qi and blood flow for the shi type. (The handout does not elaborate further on the mechanism.)
key_manifestations_zh: 產後乳汁分泌量少，不足以餵養嬰兒
甚則乳汁全無
可兼見血虛、消化吸收不良（虛證）或情志不舒、乳絡不暢（實證）之兼症
key_manifestations_en: Postpartum milk secretion is scanty and insufficient to feed the baby
In severe cases there is no milk secretion at all
Accompanying features may include blood deficiency and poor digestion or absorption (xu type), or emotional stress with obstructed flow (shi type)

records.definition_zh: 絕經前後諸證指在絕經前後出現的一組症狀與體徵，其輕重與持續時間因人而異，差別甚大。
records.definition_en: Menopausal syndrome refers to a group of symptoms and signs coming up before or after menopause. The severity and duration of these symptoms may vary greatly from case to case.
records.etiology_zh: 腎氣漸衰，衝任虛損空虛，陰陽失於平衡。
records.etiology_en: Kidney Qi declining with the Chong and Ren becoming empty, and imbalance between Yin and Yang.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 絕經之際腎氣衰退，衝任二脈虛空，陰陽失調，遂生諸證，證候分屬腎陰虛與腎陽虛兩端。治當補腎、調理衝任。
records.pathomechanism_en: Around menopause, kidney Qi declines and the Chong and Ren become empty; the balance between Yin and Yang is lost, giving rise to the various symptoms, which are differentiated into Kidney Yin deficiency and Kidney Yang deficiency. Treatment tonifies the kidneys and regulates the Chong and Ren.
key_manifestations_zh: 情緒不穩，煩躁易怒
精神萎靡，倦怠乏力
汗出，眩暈，心悸
失眠，健忘，耳鳴
五心煩熱，口渴，蟻走感
腰痠，甚者可見精神失常
key_manifestations_en: Emotional lability and irritability
Listlessness and fatigue
Sweating, dizziness, and palpitation
Insomnia, forgetfulness, and tinnitus
Five-center burn, thirst, and formication
Lumbar soreness, and in extreme cases even psychosis

records.definition_zh: 癮疹為常見之過敏性皮膚病證，以皮膚驟起扁平隆起之風團為特徵，形如麻疹或如扁豆大小，時起時消。因每於受風後發作，中醫又名「風疹塊」；以其忽隱忽現，故稱「癮疹」，即西醫所稱蕁麻疹。
records.definition_en: Urticaria is a common allergic skin disorder, an eruption of skin characterized by temporary, flat-topped wheals that look like measles or are as large as broad beans. Because it tends to appear after exposure to wind it is named "wind wheal" in TCM, and because it comes and goes it is also named "hidden rash"; another term for it is hives.
records.etiology_zh: 一、濕邪蘊於肌膚，復感風熱或風寒之邪；二、胃腸積熱，復感風邪；三、腸道寄生蟲，或對魚、蝦、蟹等食物過敏。
records.etiology_en: 1. Damp retained in the skin and muscles, attacked by wind-heat or wind-cold; 2. Accumulated heat in the Stomach and intestines, attacked by wind; 3. Intestinal parasites, or allergy to foods such as fish, shrimp, or crab.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 風邪與濕、熱相搏，鬱於肌膚腠理之間，發為風團；風性善行數變，故疹塊驟起驟消、此起彼伏，並可隨天氣變化而加重或減輕。急性者消退較速；重者風邪壅盛，可見面咽腫脹，甚則氣道閉阻。
records.pathomechanism_en: Wind combines with damp or heat and becomes constrained in the skin and interstices, erupting as wheals; as wind is mobile and changeable, the wheals arise and subside abruptly, appearing one after another, and may be aggravated or alleviated by weather changes. Acute conditions subside quickly; in severe reactions the face and throat may swell, rarely causing breathing difficulty or closing of the throat.
key_manifestations_zh: 驟起搔癢劇烈之隆起風團，色紅或淡紅，大小形狀不一
疹塊此起彼伏，時隱時現，可持續數分鐘至數日
可發於身體任何部位，以四肢與軀幹為多見
可隨天氣變化而加重或減輕
重者面部咽喉腫脹，甚則呼吸困難
key_manifestations_en: Abrupt onset of intensely itchy, raised, red or light-red wheals varying in size and shape
Wheals rise one after another, coming and going, lasting from a few minutes to several days
May appear on any part of the body, most commonly the arms, legs, and trunk
May be aggravated or alleviated by weather change
In severe cases the face and throat swell, rarely causing trouble breathing
